answer: What survives to the ridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sonnet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the shale of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, re-queued for a second panel. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
